name: Chittagong Rashtrabhasha Sangram Parishad
contribution: The Chittagong Rashtrabhasha Sangram Parishad organized language-rights activism in Chittagong and carried the Language Movement beyond Dhaka.
context: Its work belongs to the regional spread of the movement before and after February 1952, when meetings, strikes, and public campaigns connected local grievances to the province-wide demand for Bangla.
impact: The committee shows that the Language Movement was not only a capital-centred student agitation. Regional organizations helped turn language recognition into a province-wide political claim.
highlight: Chittagong regional committee that extended the Language Movement beyond Dhaka.
seoDescription: Learn how the Chittagong Rashtrabhasha Sangram Parishad helped spread Bangladesh's Language Movement beyond Dhaka.
shortAnswer: The Chittagong Rashtrabhasha Sangram Parishad was a regional committee that organized language-rights protests in Chittagong.

faq.question: Why was the Chittagong committee important?
faq.answer: It helped regionalize the Language Movement by organizing language-rights activism beyond Dhaka.
